import ida_hexrays,idautils,ida_funcs,json
addresses=[0x4a92b8,0x4a8efc,0x4a8f0c,0x4a8e8c,0x4a9064]
result=[]
for ea in addresses:
 c=ida_hexrays.decompile(ea)
 result.append({'address':hex(ea),'code':str(c) if c else None,'callers':[{'address':hex(x.frm),'function':hex(ida_funcs.get_func(x.frm).start_ea) if ida_funcs.get_func(x.frm) else None} for x in idautils.XrefsTo(ea)]})
print(json.dumps(result))
